decisions.reason: After another year, this core safety-shoe line still fits the firm's main capabilities and channels, and its continued presence suggests enough promise to keep the option open.

The supportive insole is inexpensive to maintain, but in a crowded insole portfolio and alongside the flagship moulded insole it remains the most at-risk option unless its differentiation becomes clearer.
These firefighter and rescue boots are a specialized niche, yet they leverage the firm's protective-footwear know-how and are worth retaining while the market opportunity continues to clarify.
Because it was positioned as a flagship product and aligns with the firm's innovation direction, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it without clear evidence of failure.
